needed.evidence: green metal fence separates the road from a narrow strip of vegetation with no paved walking surface
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk behind the green fence on the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: The walking area is narrow, unpaved, and obstructed by parked vehicles and poles
needed.suggestion: Install a proper, wide, paved sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Parked white vans and cars are occupying the edge of the road where pedestrians would walk
needed.suggestion: Implement strict no-parking zones on the right side to keep the pedestrian path clear.

needed.evidence: The ground surface on the right is uneven and consists of dirt and debris
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the walking area on the right side to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: There is high crossing demand due to commercial shops and a junction, but no marked or signalised pedestrian crossing
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at the junction to allow safe crossing.
